Every ticket for the Vancouver trip — and where each one is cheaper

Four things to buy for 3 people, checked on the official sites: student discounts, online vs at-the-counter prices, and the cheapest way to get each one.

Tue Nov 10 – Fri Nov 13, 2026 3 people · University of Alberta students, age 21 All prices CAD Checked on official sites Tue Nov 10, 2026

Only 1 of 4 has a student discount

The Vancouver Lookout: $16.93 with student ID instead of $23.88. Sea to Sky, Grouse and Skylynx have no student rate at all.

Online wins once — by $24

Sea to Sky Gondola is $73.95 online vs $81.95 at the window. Everything else is the same price either way, as far as the official sites publish.

$684.33 for all four, for 3

As listed — but two of the four prices are pre-tax. With estimated 5% GST on those, budget about $701.72. Breakdown below.

Buy them in this order

Ordered by what can sell out, expire, or cost more if you wait — not by price.

  1. 1

    YVR Skylynx return — book online first $126.00 for 3

    Squamish is a request stop, so the coach only stops if you book ahead — and booking guarantees your seats. The price is $42 each wherever you buy it, so there's no saving in waiting. Standard tickets can't be changed or refunded; Flexible ($46 each) can, up to 24 hours before departure.

  2. 2

    Sea to Sky Gondola — buy online, not at the window $221.85 for 3

    The one clear online saving: $73.95 online vs $81.95 at the ticket window — $8 each, $24 for the group. Tickets aren't date-specific and no reservation is needed, so buying early costs nothing.

  3. 3

    Vancouver Lookout — either way, bring student ID $50.79 for 3

    Same price online and at the counter, so buy whenever suits. The student price ($16.93 vs $23.88) needs ID — have your U of A student cards ready. Open 10am–6pm, last elevator up 5:30pm.

  4. 4

    Grouse Mountain — buy last, after checking the forecast $285.69 for 3

    Grouse tickets are for a specific date and are non-refundable, so check the forecast and the mountain webcams before paying. There's no online-vs-counter saving published to chase.

Item by item

Adult price, student discount (or the lack of one), online vs counter, and the total for 3 — with the catch on each, where there is one.

Vancouver Lookout

Observation deck · Downtown Vancouver · Open 10am–6pm, last elevator up 5:30pm

Student discount — the only one of the four Same price online & at the counter
Adult / Senior$23.88
Student — ID required$16.93saves $6.95 each (~29%)
Children 6–17 · Infants 0–5$16.93 · $0infants free with a paying adult
Cheapest for 3 students $50.79 taxes & fees included
  • Student proof: the official site says only “ID Required” and states no BC-only or U-Pass restriction — a U of A student ID should qualify on that wording, but the site doesn't explicitly confirm out-of-province students, so bring the ID and be ready to show it.
  • Online vs counter: no separate walk-up price is published — the booking-widget price is the price. Independent guides list the same figures for on-site purchase and say the student discount is applied at the ticket counter.
  • Entry is one-time only — you can't leave and come back on the same ticket. Same prices shown for every day of the trip, Tue Nov 10 – Fri Nov 13.
  • At adult price, 3 would cost $71.64 — the student rate saves the group $20.85.

Source: vancouverlookout.com (booking widget, read Nov 10, 2026)

Sea to Sky Gondola

Squamish · Round-trip day ticket — Summit Lodge, trails & suspension bridge included · 9am–5pm, last ride down 6pm

No student discount Buy online — saves $8 per ticket
Adult (19–64) — online$73.95
Adult — at the ticket window$81.95
Senior 65+ · Youth 13–18 · Child 6–12$68.95 · $43.95 · $29.95online prices; under 5 free
Cheapest for 3 adults — online $221.85 before tax
  • No student category exists on the official price table — at 21 you're an Adult (19–64). Ignore third-party sellers advertising a Sea to Sky student rate; the official table contradicts them.
  • Online is cheaper by $8 a ticket — $221.85 for 3 online vs $245.85 at the window. Tickets aren't date-specific and no reservation is needed.
  • Tax is not included in the listed prices (“plus applicable taxes”). At 5% GST the 3-person total would be about $232.94 — an estimate; the official checkout wasn't completed to verify it.
  • The gondola is closed Nov 16–26 for maintenance — the Nov 10–13 trip dates are safely before that.

Source: seatoskygondola.com/hours-and-prices (read Nov 10, 2026)

Grouse Mountain

North Vancouver · Mountain Admission — round-trip Skyride/Gondola plus open mountaintop attractions

No student discount on general admission One published price — $89
Adult (19–64)$89.00before tax
Senior 65+ · Youth 13–18 · Child 5–12 · Family (2A/2C)$79 · $69 · $49 · $229
Lower Mainland Resident rate$74.00does not apply — you're from Alberta
For 3 adults — online checkout total $285.69 incl. GST + fee
  • What the $89 becomes at checkout: 3 × $89 = $267.00, plus a $5.34 processing fee and $13.35 GST (5%, no PST) = $285.69. No separate ticket-window price is published; buying in person might avoid the $5.34 fee ($280.35) — that wasn't verified, so don't count on it.
  • The student offer you can't use: “CIBC Student Nights” gives students 50% off Sunset Tickets — Mondays only, in person 6–8pm. The trip (Tue–Fri) has no Monday, and it's not general daytime admission anyway.
  • Tickets are dated and non-refundable, valid only for the day selected. Admission excludes skiing/snowboarding, the Bike Park and the Grouse Grind.
  • Closed during your visit: Kids Tree Canopy Adventure (Nov 2–13); Lumberjack Show, Birds in Motion and Peak Chairlift are closed for the 2026 season; the Grouse Grind was closed for maintenance until Tue Nov 10.
  • One unverified tip, from a third-party guide only: showing a transit fare at Guest Services may get $10 off Mountain Admission. It's not on the official site and isn't in the totals — but it's free to ask if you take transit up.

Sources: grousemountain.com — Buy Mountain Admission · grousemountain.com/cibc (read Nov 10, 2026)

YVR Skylynx — coach to Squamish

Downtown Vancouver ↔ Squamish, return · Pickup by the Hyatt Regency, Melville St / Burrard Station · Squamish: Adventure Centre, 38551 Loggers Lane

No student discount Same price everywhere — book online for the seats
Standard return$42.00non-refundable, non-changeable
Flexible return$46.00refundable/changeable to 24h before
One-way — Standard / Flexible$32.00 / $35.00
Cheapest for 3 — Standard return $126.00 tax status unverified
  • No student fare. The booking form only has Adult (13+), Child 6–12 and Infant. The only discounts are for Sea to Sky locals (proof of local address — not you), 10% off for groups of 10+ (you're 3), children at 50% off and under-6s free.
  • No walk-up price difference is published. You can also buy at the YVR kiosk, by phone, at Tourism Squamish/Whistler, or from the driver if seats remain — but Squamish is a request stop, so book online in advance to be sure the coach stops and has room.
  • Tax is the open question: the official prices page doesn't say whether tax is included, and the booking checkout couldn't be read to confirm. A 2026 traveller review quoted “$44.10 with taxes” for a round trip — exactly $42 × 1.05 — suggesting 5% GST is added, which would make it $132.30 for 3. Not verified.
  • Downtown Vancouver ↔ Squamish and ↔ Whistler are the same fare. The fall schedule (Apr 18 – Nov 21, 2026) covers the trip dates.

Sources: yvrskylynx.com/prices · yvrskylynx.com/faqs (read Nov 10, 2026)

Discounts that look real but don't apply to you

All of these appear on official pages or booking screens during Nov 10–13 — and none of them lowers your price.

Not for this group

  • Grouse “Fall Special — 50% off, Nov 9–13”: it's 50% off the Lower Mainland resident rate only. You're Alberta students, so the standard $89 stands — even though the special runs exactly during your trip.
  • Grouse date-picker prices ($37 / $84 adult): the booking calendar shows lower figures for Nov 10–13, but the pricing table, ticket page and cart all charge $89. $89 is the payable price.
  • CIBC Student Nights at Grouse: 50% off Sunset Tickets, Mondays only — no Monday in a Tue Nov 10 – Fri Nov 13 trip.
  • CIBC cardholder 15% off at Grouse: only Dec 11–18, 2026 (and later windows), and needs a CIBC credit card — not your dates.
  • Skylynx locals discount & group discount: locals need a Squamish/Whistler address; groups need 10+ people.
  • Sea to Sky “student rates” on third-party sellers: no student category exists on the official price table.

Still not verified — treat with care

  • Lookout student eligibility: official wording is just “ID Required” with no BC restriction stated — likely fine with a U of A ID, but not confirmed in writing.
  • Lookout walk-up price: no separate door price is published; treated as the same as online, backed by guides listing identical on-site prices.
  • Grouse at the counter: no in-person price published — the $5.34 online processing fee may or may not apply at Guest Services.
  • Sea to Sky tax-included total: checkout wasn't completed; prices are “plus applicable taxes,” so the $232.94 GST-included figure for 3 is an estimate.
  • Skylynx tax: not stated on the official site, and the booking results page wouldn't load to check a cart total. The $44.10-with-taxes figure is one traveller's report.
